results.content:
According to The Economist and YouGov, more people disapprove than approve of Trump's job performance in 47 out of 50 states and in the District of Columbia. The three states where the majority of respondents still approve of the president are Wyoming (+14), Idaho (+9), and West Virginia (+6).

All three went for Trump in the 2016, 2020, and 2024 presidential elections.

According to the latest survey from The Economist/YouGov, 80% of Republicans approve of Trump's performance, while 18% disapprove.

## Lowest presidential approval rating

The record for the lowest individual approval rating in a single poll belongs to Harry S. Truman, who hit 22% in February 1952.

Two August Economist/YouGov surveys showed Trump’s net approval (those who approve minus those who disapprove) improving by more than 10 points among the voter groups.

It comes ahead of the November midterm elections, when the president’s standing could influence Republican candidates competing for control of Congress.
